notes.title: v4.0 - Polish and Japanese Localization!
notes.content:
Draw Games Developers here with the final localization update!

[h3]Polish and Japanese Localization[/h3]
Thanks to the help of our amazing volunteers, we now have Polish and Japanese in-game translations! If you find any mistakes or bugs, contact us at drawgamesdev@gmail.com or join our [url=https://discord.gg/chYYRHYUgE]community Discord[/url].

notes.title: v3.0 - German, French, Spanish, and Traditional Chinese Localization!
notes.content:
Draw Games Developers here! We're astounded to see our game reach such a diverse audience, and we wanted to reach even more players around the world!

[h3]German, French, Spanish, and Traditional Chinese Localization[/h3]
Thanks to the help of our amazing volunteers, we now have German, French, and Spanish in-game translations! We've also added support for traditional Chinese. If you happen to find any mistakes or bugs, contact us at drawgamesdev@gmail.com or join our [url=https://discord.gg/chYYRHYUgE]community Discord[/url].

Thanks again for all the support!

Draw Games Developers

notes.title: v2.0 - Chinese Localization, New Achievements, and OST Release!
notes.content:
Draw Developers team here! Thank you so much for all the love and support for the game since our release just a month ago! Based on your feedback and review, we have a couple of exciting announcements.

[h3]Chinese Localization[/h3]
To all the folks requesting Chinese translations, we hear you! We now have Chinese translations for the in-game dialogue and UI! In the latest update, use the button in the top-right corner of the main menu to choose between English and Simplified Chinese.

[h3]Additional Achievements[/h3]
We've also added five new achievements, including two new hand-animated alternate cutscenes and dialogue, waiting to be unlocked. Best of luck, achievement hunters and game completionists!

[h3]OST Release[/h3]
Enjoyed the music from the game? Now you can listen to them outside of the game! Our original soundtrack featuring 9 tracks by our composer Sheyn Muncada is [url=store.steampowered.com/app/2645710/Draw_OST]now available for download on Steam[/url]!

[h3]Other Fixes[/h3]
We've been made aware of some players struggling with the Mike Part 2 Bowling Ball Puzzle, so we've made some adjustments accordingly to make things more clear.

Thanks again for all the support. Enjoy the update!

Draw Games Developers

notes.title: Draw Community Discord
notes.content:
Hello! Recently, we decided to make a Discord server for Draw's community! 

https://discord.gg/chYYRHYUgE

With this, we hope to create a space for people to share their thoughts on Draw! Whether it be sharing strategies and screenshots and reporting bugs, analyzing and theorizing about the messages of the game, or even sharing creative works, feel free to hop in and say hi! 

Thank you again so much for all the support, and have a great day!

Draw Games Developers

notes.title: v1.1
notes.content:
We've kept an eye on the reviews and were blown away by the positive feedback for the game! The Draw team greatly appreciates everyone who has tried out our game and interacted with the community! It's been a long run working on this game and it's amazing to see everyone enjoying it.

With some feedback, here are a few of the patches we've released for the game!

[list]
[*] Fixed some issues with the bowling puzzle in Mike Part 2
[*] Widened the tunnel in the end of the Chase level
[*] Adjusted ambient sound effects in Nathan Part 2 and 3
[/list]
